articles.title: Reporting Security Vulnerabilities
articles.content: If you discover a security vulnerability in Claude, report it through Anthropic's responsible disclosure program. Email security@anthropic.com with details. Do not publicly disclose the vulnerability until Anthropic has had time to investigate and fix it. Anthropic may offer rewards through their bug bounty program.

articles.title: Web Crawling Opt-Out
articles.content: To prevent Claude from using your website data for training, you can: 1) Use robots.txt to block Anthropic's crawler, 2) Contact Anthropic directly to request exclusion, 3) Use the opt-out form on Anthropic's website. Note: This only affects future training, not data already used.
